
---

Klipp 17U is a fork of [Klipp](https://github.com/Flabbjaxaren/klipp) by Flabbjaxaren (GPL-3.0-only). It installs beside Klipp as **Klipp 17U** (`x17u.klipp.editor`); the two apps don't share projects. Everything the fork adds or changes: [CHANGELOG-17U.md](https://github.com/utalpt/klipp/blob/xiaomi-17u/CHANGELOG-17U.md). Source: this release's tag.
